Meet RA Fahim: The Developer and Creator Behind Wishly

Wishly was created around a simple idea: people should be able to turn a personal message, memory or celebration into a small digital experience without needing to learn web development. This is the story of RA Fahim, the developer and creator behind the project.

RA FahimFounder & Developer, Wishly · Author profile
Founder story · Developer profile5 min readUpdated 7 November 2026

Who is RA Fahim?

RA Fahim is a web developer and creator from Bangladesh. His work focuses on building modern websites, web applications, SaaS products, e-commerce platforms and practical digital products. He is the founder and developer behind Wishly.

His public work and professional profile are available at rafahim.com. This article focuses on his role in creating Wishly and the product idea behind it.

The idea behind Wishly

Some moments are difficult to express in a single chat message. A birthday wish may need a collection of memories; a proposal may benefit from a story; an apology may need a thoughtful letter; and a wedding invitation may need event details presented clearly. RA Fahim wanted to make it easier to build these kinds of personal pages and share them through one link.

Wishly was launched on October 10. The idea was to make meaningful digital experiences approachable for people who do not code, while leaving room for each creator to personalize the words, images and design.

What Wishly helps people create

Wishly is a browser-based personal website maker for occasions such as birthdays, proposals, anniversaries, weddings, friendship, apologies and digital letters. People can start from a template, customize supported content in a visual editor, preview the result and publish a shareable page.

Depending on the selected template and available controls, creators can personalize text, add images and use supported media or interactive sections. Design settings may also allow changes to themes and fonts. The exact options can vary from one template to another.

A product built around the person receiving the page

The product idea is not simply to put a website online. It is to help someone create a message that feels personal to the person opening it. That means keeping the workflow understandable, making the result comfortable to view on phones and giving creators a straightforward way to share the finished page.

For RA Fahim, product development connects interface design with practical details: how someone chooses a template, edits their content, checks the page and shares it with confidence. Those details shape the experience as much as the visual design.

What comes next for Wishly

Wishly continues to evolve as a digital product. New templates, improvements to the editor and changes to the available customization options may be introduced over time. The main Wishly website is the best place to see the current product, explore the templates and check the latest available features.

Visit Wishly to explore the platform, or read the Wishly Guide library for practical tutorials and ideas.

Connect with RA Fahim

For more about his web development work and digital projects, visit RA Fahim’s website. You can also find his public code projects on GitHub and connect through his Facebook or Instagram profiles.

To explore the product itself, visit the official Wishly website.
